reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: Works great at EXPO settings on my Asus X870 MAX Gaming Motherboard with AMD Ryzen 9 9950X CPU.
reviews.author: Tom S

reviews.title: Works!
reviews.comment: Work great in my HP Omen 45L with RTX 5090 and intel ultra9 285k at rated speeds.
reviews.author: Marcesq

reviews.title: Solid kit of ram
reviews.comment: Works just fine and fits most CPU coolers.
reviews.author: Jaye Taylor

reviews.title: Advertised Speed not Correct
reviews.comment: Product advertised as 6400mhz and the box it arrived in (with same model number) clearly says 6000. I looked it up on Predator website and the 6400 chips are part number 9bWWR.438 not .437
reviews.author: Rich R

reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.comment: Does not boot with XMP profile at 6000. Manually adjusted down to 5600 and will not POST. Requires standard 4800 timing to boot. I thought I was getting a good deal on fast memory, but ended up with slow RAM at a higher price. This is getting returned.
reviews.author: Remy
